children: HP Inc. (NYSE:HPQ) reported Q3 revenue of $15.7B with strong Personal Systems despite PC units down ~16%, raised FY26 EPS guidance and posted ~$1.6B FCF, struck a multiyear Wi‑Fi patent deal with Huawei and won analyst price‑target lifts as it pushes enterprise AI and security plans.
: HPQ Q3 revenue $15.68–15.7B (+12.5%), Personal Systems $11.8B, PC units down ~16%. GAAP EPS $0.71, non-GAAP $0.83. FCF ~$1.6B. Raised FY26 EPS to $2.52–2.62 GAAP.
: HP Inc. (HPQ) struck a multiyear global patent cross‑license with Huawei on Aug 26, 2026, granting HP rights to certain Huawei Wi‑Fi patents, including Wi‑Fi 7; no financials disclosed.
: Analysts raised 12‑month price targets for HP Inc. (HPQ): TD Cowen to $30, Evercore ISI to $32, and UBS to $28, reflecting higher valuations for the stock.
: HP Inc. (HPQ) plans enterprise AI across three layers: smart PCs/peripherals, a workplace ecosystem for AI agents, and an IT control plane using Wolf Security and Workforce Experience Platform.
